source_order.source: Meridian design decision (SPEC §2.3, §4): local-first, no live feeds in v0
source_order.notes: 1) Use a rate printed on the source document where present; 2) else nearest ledger fx_rates entry; 3) else operator manual entry. No network FX lookups in v0.

nearest_rate_max_staleness_days.source: Meridian design decision: consolidation refuses silently-stale FX
nearest_rate_max_staleness_days.notes: If the nearest ledger rate to the valuation date is older than this, the figure renders with an explicit staleness warning; beyond 31 days the conversion is refused and requires manual entry.

date_mismatch_rule.source: Meridian design decision: never use a rate later than the valuation date, so a valuation is reproducible from data available on that date

rounding.source: Meridian design decision: banker's rounding on presentation only; engine keeps full precision internally
